description: This file contains functions and structures for inferring and creating function schemas in the PyTorch ATen library, including type checking, argument creation, and schema generation.

classes.name: ArgumentDef
classes.description: Represents argument definitions used during schema inference, created at compile time to reduce binary size.

methods.name: checkStaticTypes
methods.description: Checks C++ types for correctness, supporting only int8_t, int64_t, bool, and disallowing float.

methods.name: createArguments
methods.description: Creates argument definitions from a list of C++ types.

methods.name: createReturns
methods.description: Creates return argument definitions from a tuple or single type.

methods.name: createFunctionSchemaFromTraitsFlattenedReturns
methods.description: Creates a FunctionSchema with flattened return types from function traits.

methods.name: createFunctionSchemaFromTraitsSingleReturn
methods.description: Creates a FunctionSchema preserving tuple return types from function traits.
